title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
summary: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI with a focus on music technology, returning with support and funding from music labels. This represents a strategic pivot for the company and a reconciliation with an industry he previously disrupted.
content: Sean Parker, who once taught the music industry what asking for forgiveness looks like, is now back with the labels' blessing and money.

zh.title: 肖恩·帕克正在围绕音乐重建Stability AI
zh.summary: 肖恩·帕克正在围绕音乐技术对Stability AI进行重组，获得了音乐标签的支持和资金。这代表了公司的战略转向，也是对他曾经破坏过的行业的和解。

title: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
summary: Meta has open-sourced code enabling users to build custom Muse AI gadgets on affordable hardware like ESP32 boards and Raspberry Pis. The company is encouraging DIY projects ranging from E Ink displays to HDMI sticks, democratizing access to its AI assistant technology.
content:
Meta now lets you make your own Muse gadgets that feature the company's new AI agent with code that the company open sourced. The company suggests projects like loading Muse on a color E Ink display to show reminders, adding it to an HDMI stick so you can display Muse on a big screen, or putting Muse on a small touchscreen device to make what looks kind of like a DIY Muse Charm.
"Muse gadgets are open source devices you build yourself," Meta says. "Program an off-the-shelf ESP32 board or set up a Raspberry Pi with our SDKs, then connect Muse to your displays, buttons, sensors, actuators, and whatever else you've got lying on your workbench. …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Meta开源代码让你制作Muse AI小工具
zh.summary: Meta已开源代码，使用户能够在ESP32开发板和树莓派等廉价硬件上创建自定义的Muse AI小工具。该公司正在鼓励从电子墨水屏幕到HDMI棒的DIY项目，使其AI助手技术的使用更加民主化。

title: Amazon’s $1B plan to combat data center backlash draws more backlash
summary: Amazon announced a $1 billion initiative to address concerns about its data center expansion, receiving mixed reactions from stakeholders. While the company was praised for ending non-disclosure agreements, critics argue it underestimates the environmental impact of its data infrastructure.
content: Amazon praised for ending NDAs but slammed for downplaying data center pollution.

zh.title: 亚马逊的10亿美元数据中心计划反而引发更多反对
zh.summary: 亚马逊宣布了一项10亿美元的举措来应对对其数据中心扩张的担忧，但获得了利益相关者的不同反应。虽然该公司因终止保密协议而受到赞扬，但批评人士认为它低估了其数据基础设施的环保影响。

title: Netflix is pivoting away from prestige
summary: Netflix is ending several prestigious production partnerships with acclaimed directors like David Fincher and Shawn Levy, signaling a strategic shift away from prestige content. The move comes as the streaming landscape consolidates with major competitors like Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery merging.
content:
Many of Netflix's biggest critically acclaimed hits have been the products of its multiyear production deals with noted directors like David Fincher and Shawn Levy. In the past few weeks, though, the streamer has brought some of those partnerships to an end in a way that feels indicative of a larger strategic shift. With rival studios Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery on the verge of a megamerger that will reshape the entertainment landscape, Netflix is clearly thinking about how it can continue to hold its own in the ongoing streaming wars. But as the company charts its path forward, its plan to court subscribers might not put so much em …

zh.title: Netflix正在远离精品内容
zh.summary: Netflix正在结束与大卫·芬奇和肖恩·利维等著名导演的多项精品制作合作,标志着该公司在战略上远离精品内容。此举正值流媒体行业整合加速,Paramount和Warner Bros. Discovery等主要竞争对手合并之际。

title: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk
summary: Apple is implementing stricter controls on macOS "full disk access" permissions to mitigate security risks from increasingly capable AI agents. The change requires users to explicitly authorize apps seeking broad access to files, messages, and browsing history.
content:
Apple will add new limits for "full disk access" on Mac in response to risks posed by AI agents, as reported earlier by TechCrunch. In an update on Friday, Apple says it's rolling out new controls to "ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action."
The change comes just weeks after Inc's Jason Aten found that Meta's Muse AI somehow knew the contents of his messages, despite not giving the chatbot explicit permission to access them on his iPhone or Mac. Meta spokesperson Andy Stone pushed back on this report, saying access to Messages is "entirely opt-in. …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: 苹果正在对macOS"完全磁盘访问"权限实施更严格的控制,以减轻能力日益强大的AI代理所带来的安全风险。该更改要求用户明确授权那些寻求对文件、消息和浏览历史进行广泛访问的应用。

title: Patient-zero drill put health facilities to the test—40% of them failed
summary: A health system emergency preparedness drill using actors simulating patients found that 40% of 73 participating healthcare facilities failed to respond adequately. The exercise tested how well institutions could handle potential disease outbreak scenarios.
content: Actors with makeup and fake symptoms staggered into 73 healthcare facilities.

title: Sling TV drops its one-day cable passes
summary: Sling TV is discontinuing its Sling Pass feature that offered flexible short-term cable TV subscriptions without requiring full-month commitments. Despite a judge initially ruling against Disney's injunction attempt, the service is being shut down amid legal pressure from major media companies.
content:
Dish-owned Sling TV will no longer be offering its Sling Pass feature that allowed people to buy a single day of cable TV programming at a time, as reported by The Desk.
The feature was announced last year and offered a day pass, a weekend pass, and a week-long pass option to be able to watch channels like ESPN and CNN without a full-month cable subscription. But soon after it launched, Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery sued Sling TV over Sling Pass, though a federal judge ruled against Disney in its request for a preliminary injunction to block the feature.
"Sling was built to give our customers the ultimate control over their entertainme …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Sling TV 停止其一日电缆通行证
zh.summary: Sling TV正在停止其Sling Pass功能，该功能提供灵活的短期有线电视订阅，无需全月承诺。尽管法官最初裁定反对迪士尼的禁令申请，但该服务正在大型媒体公司的法律压力下关闭。

summary: Lyft has agreed to a $272.5 million settlement in a landmark lawsuit over driver misclassification, though labor advocates argue the payout remains insufficient. The case highlights ongoing disputes over gig workers' employment status and compensation.
content: Critics say workers are still owed far more.

title: The 2008 economic crisis changed the US's relationship with energy
summary: The 2008 financial crisis marked a turning point in US energy policy, decoupling carbon emissions from economic growth. This shift has had lasting implications for the country's approach to energy consumption and climate considerations.
content: It wasn't obvious at the time, but the US uncoupled carbon emissions and GDP growth.

summary: U.S. authorities arrested a tech CEO for allegedly smuggling $300 million worth of Nvidia chips to China, continuing a pattern of illegal chip exports. The case reflects ongoing tensions between U.S. export controls and global demand for advanced semiconductors.
content: Nvidia’s chip-smuggling problem won’t go away as arrests continue.

content: Also: Spooky action at the LHC, Ice Age psychoactive use, yeast for building homes on Mars, and more.

title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
summary: Apple is tightening macOS Full Disk Access controls to address security risks posed by increasingly sophisticated AI agents. The change aims to prevent apps from gaining broad access to sensitive user data including files, messages, and browsing history without explicit authorization.
content: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.

title: OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner
summary: OpenAI has launched Dots, a new AI agent platform designed for enterprise use that can also perform consumer tasks like ordering food. Unlike Meta's more consumer-focused Muse, Dots emphasize workplace productivity while maintaining an approachable interface with customizable avatars.
content:
New helpful little guy just dropped. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge	

It's a tale as old as last week: OpenAI's new agent platform, called Dots, is full of cute little guys who can do your bidding. 
But unlike the ultra-approachable Meta Muse, Dots feel very much like using workplace software that happens to be able to order you a burrito - emphasis on work. 
OpenAI announced Dots earlier this week. Like Muse, Dots have blobby, anthropomorphic avatars and customizable names. In the future, OpenAI says you'll be able to have multiple Dots, but right now you get one. I named mine Dotty McDotface.
The interface looks similar to Muse's; you chat with the agent in one window and follow its work in another as it  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

title: It’s not AI anymore, it’s ‘super intelligence’ (according to the White House)

The move reflects growing government engagement with AI development while companies emphasize user-friendly AI interfaces.
content: This week, the White House got nearly every major tech CEO in one room — Zuckerberg, Bezos, Musk, and Anthropic’s Dario Amodei among them — to sign an AI safety pledge that President Donald Trump called “morally binding.” Trump also signed an executive order officially rebranding AI as “super intelligence,” and meanwhile, Meta and OpenAI are putting friendlier faces on their AI products, even as the biggest money […]
